title: Regular City Council Meeting 02/17/26
caveat: Findings from an automated review of an auto-captioned recording. Verify specifics against the video before repeating them.

findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council conducted regular business approving parade resolutions, enterprise zone amendments, property acquisitions, and development extensions. Notably, the council approved a resolution committing local matching funds for a federal grant application to install an advanced ozone treatment system at the Water Treatment Plant.

topics.topic: Water Treatment Plant Advanced Ozone Treatment System
topics.what_happened: The council considered and unanimously approved Resolution No. 2026-3336 supporting an application for FY27 Community Project Funding for an advanced ozone treatment system at the Water Treatment Plant. City staff explained that Mattoon is seeking a $3 million federal grant with a required 20% local match not to exceed $600,000. Mayor Hall noted that this grant application represents the start of one of the city's major infrastructure projects.
topics.speakers: city administrator, mayor, city council members

action_items.action: Commit matching local funds not to exceed $600,000 toward the FY27 Community Project Funding application for the Water Treatment Plant advanced ozone treatment system

votes.measure: Resolution No. 2026-3336 supporting application for FY27 Community Project Funding and matching local funds up to $600,000 for an advanced ozone treatment system at the Water Treatment Plant
